senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced. wds.) enclosure, chamber, secret compartment.
units: B. Bath. IV, 1 הח׳ וכ׳ the special enclosure for storage inside of the building; a. fr.—Trnsf. the inner part of the female genitals, the upper end of the vagina or uterus.
<cite ref="Niddah 17b">Ib. 17ᵇ</cite>; Y. ib. II, 50ᵃ top.—Pl. <he>חֲדָרִים</he>. <he>בחַדְרֵי ח׳</he> in the remotest recesses, in strict secrecy.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:4">Cant. R. to I, 4</cite> (<he>הביאני</he>) <he>ח׳ בהמות וכ׳</he> the mysteries of Behemoth &c.; <he>ח׳ מרכבה</he>, v. <cite ref="M02700"><he>מֶרְכָּבָה</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 982:2">Yalk. Cant. 982</cite>.
